## Summary

What changed and why it matters.

## Context

Linked issue or owner instruction, milestone/version if supplied, explicit base branch and why it is correct.
Use closing keywords only for complete coverage and intended closure behavior; otherwise use `Related`.

## Changes

Scope, approach, key files, and intentional non-goals.

## Validation

```text
Passed / Failed / Blocked / Not run: command, result, environment, tested revision/artifact
```

Tests added or existing coverage; screenshots for visible changes or the exact proof gap.
Keep local, CI, packaged, editor/browser and production checks distinct.
State the platform and exploration/delivery stage, then observable behavior and appearance results; phrase checks alone are not product proof.

## Risks And Follow-Up

Risk:
Rollback plan:
Compatibility/migration and release impact:
Owner decisions:
Local commits and remote delivery authorization/effects:
Next action:

Delegated chat/worktree reference when applicable.
`Changelog:` verified audience-facing item, or `Not applicable - internal only: reason`, for milestone issue PRs.
